text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: To the challenge! Alright, let's send Myu-chan this time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とうちゃーく！
よーし、
今度こそみゅ～ちゃんを送ってあげるぞ～！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: The power in this gate is stronger than the last...! With this, it should surely lead to the other side!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきのゲートより力が強いね……！
これなら、
きっと向こう側まで通じるはず！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: It's a little scary... But it's alright! It's for Myu-chan's sake!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっぴりこわいけど……
大丈夫！
みゅ～ちゃんのためだもんっ！
